population: Prospective same-priced game seller with comparable full-price and discounted eligible event cohorts; no real seller data
unit: Aligned eligible page-view event, paid positive-price order event or refund event; not unique people
period: Official sale/payment features current at Oct 27 2026; future predeclared baseline and campaign windows
sample_frame: Official creator sale, pricing, payment guidance, 2018 analytics history and 2025 fee-waiver announcement
limits: Same calendar times and audience labels do not establish actual randomization or identical individual buyers.
100% discount acquisitions are not retained positive-price orders.
Operator-fee waiver changes seller contribution, not necessarily buyer price.
Historical 2018 exposure reporting is not verified identical in the 2026 dashboard.
A synthetic audit cannot independently verify seller source records, refunds or causal results.
